podcast.title: Classical One-Hit Wonder
podcast.body: Johann Pachelbel is considered a classical one-hit wonder, with his "Canon in D" being his only widely recognized piece, despite a prolific career spanning many compositions. He is often cited alongside other classical composers like Jeremiah Clark, Samuel Barber, and Thomas Albinoni who are known predominantly for a single popular work. "Unless you're really into classical music, you probably can't name another thing he did."
